specials.title: Red Dog Specials
specials.description:
Soup:
Chicken n Dumplings... 6 (cup) or 8 (bowl) ~ Old fashioned chicken and dumplings with homemade dumplings in a savory broth, loaded with vegetables and chicken.

Appetizers:
Bacon Onion Dip .. 13 ~ A rich, savory, and creamy appetizer, featuring slow cooked caramelized onions blended into a base of cream cheese and seasonings. Topped with crispy bacon and served with fried pita chips.

Smoked Trout Dip ... 16 ~ This dip features smoked trout along with cream cheese mixed with fresh herbs.
Served with fried pita bread.

Crab Rangoon Dip ... 14 ~ A combination of imitation crab, green onions, soy sauce, and cream cheese topped with a sweet chili sauce and served with fried wonton chips.

Entrées:
Mediterranean Filet Mignon Steak Salad... 36 ~ 8 oz filet mignon, grilled medium rare, sliced and served on a bed of mixed greens surrounded by grilled sweet red bell peppers, grilled red onions, and crispy grilled chickpeas. Topped with a lemon herb dressing.

Jambalaya ... 25 ~ This Louisiana classic is a hearty blend of chicken, sausage, shrimp, veggies and rice loaded with cajun and creole flavors. Served with toasted garlic bread.

Louisiana Shrimp or Oyster Po Boy ... 18 ~ Classic New Orleans sandwich served on toasted French bread, with fried shrimp or fried oysters, lettuce, tomato, and creamy remoulade sauce.

Pastrami Reuben Sandwich ... 20 ~ Hot, hand-carved pastrami, tangy sauerkraut, melted Swiss cheese, and Russian dressing on grilled marbled rye bread

Tomato Bisque... 6 (cup) or 8 (bowl) ~ A delicious blend of fire roasted tomatoes, vegetables, spices and cream. Topped with crispy croutons.

Fried Calamari ... 15 ~ Tender squid rings and tentacles, lightly dusted in breader, then deep-fried.

Entrées:
Captain's Seafood Platter ... 40 ~ Shrimp, flounder, oysters and clam strips, all lightly breaded and fried.
Served with hush puppies, French fries and coleslaw.

Pork Ribeye ... 25 ~ Herbed, grilled pork ribeye steak topped with cranberry/jalapeño relish and served with mashed potatoes and roasted carrots & jalapeños.

Dessert:
Sopapillas... 8 ~ Deep fried flour tortilla triangles, dusted with cinnamon sugar, drizzled with honey and dusted with powdered sugar
